firstSteps: Run npm run dev to launch the extension
Open any web page to see the badge this template injects
Edit src/content/styles.module.css and save to restyle the badge
useCases: A content script styled with CSS modules
Class names hashed so page styles never collide
Starting point for content scripts that need scoped CSS

store.summary: Injects a small styled badge into web pages.

justifications.Host permission <all_urls>: The content script runs on the pages the user visits to render the extension's on-page interface. Narrow this to the specific sites your extension needs before submitting.

versionHistory: 1.0.0 (unreleased): initial version from the content-css-modules template. Not yet submitted to any store.
